items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: And the piano player happened to have been Rose Murphy's husband.

ctx.x: The Club Royal was on Florence and Broadway, and the owner of that club was a Leonard Castille, and these two guys came by my house one afternoon, I guess it must have been about 4:00 o'clock, and I wasn't working at the

time. I wasn't working at the time, and they said -- I think I had just closed a job. They said, "Listen, we want you to -- we'd like to get you to help us out because our piano player is ill and he's going to be out at least a couple of weeks and we want to know could you work with us a couple of weeks." And the piano player happened to have been Rose Murphy's husband. I guess it was her first husband. Pickens, his name was Pickens. I don't remember Pickens first name, but he was a tall, lanky guy and he was a…
So we worked at the Club Royal, and then they began to get along so badly, these two brothers.
